summary: Core, CRM and HRM publish 17 native events (user updated/blocked/unblocked/deleted/role_assigned, role created/permission_granted, group created/member_added/member_removed, client deleted, chat message_added, employee created/updated) to the outbox in the transaction of the change, with the core.group, core.role, crm.chat and hrm.employee entities; modules.Natives includes hrm.Natives, and an update that changes nothing no longer publishes crm.client.updated.v1.
